claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with Nikon branding, but the exact model number (D610) is not readable from the provided angles.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: The witness notes the camera and lens are visible, but no clear close-up evidence of scratches/dents is provided.
No accessories (battery/charger/memory card) are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Wrong model identification (e.g., not actually D610).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the top plate or bottom plate) and/or the EXIF/model shown in-camera menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified Nikon DSLR (worst-case: older/unknown model) with no confirmed accessories.

risks.risk: Not fully working (shutter, autofocus, buttons, ports, or sensor issues).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a target, and a test shot with image review on the rear LCD.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working; treat as for parts/untested until a functional test is shown.

risks.risk: Lens condition problems (fungus/haze, scratches, aperture not functioning).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass under light, plus a clip showing aperture changes (or lens stops down) and a sharp test image at wide and tele/zoom end.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a lens with unknown condition; assume possible haze/scratches affecting image quality.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, cables, body cap).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item (battery model, charger, memory card, cables) with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body + lens only (no confirmed extras).

risks.risk: High shutter count / heavy usage history.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or a service/EXIF screen that indicates usage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear usage (worst-case) since shutter count is not shown.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch / scam risk due to conflicting brand statement (seller says Canon while witness sees Nikon).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model on the camera body (top housing and/or front prism area) and the lens mount branding.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for a potentially misrepresented item; proceed only after brand/model is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the exact camera model label (top/bottom plate) showing “D610” if that’s the model.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, cables) with labels visible.
Short power-on + menu + autofocus test video, ending with a reviewed test photo on the LCD.
Close-up photos of lens front and rear glass under light to check fungus/haze/scratches.
A screenshot/photo showing shutter count or usage indicator from the camera/menu.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon DSLR, but the exact model (D610) and working condition are not verifiable from the provided angles, and the seller’s brand claim conflicts with what’s seen. Without a functional test and model confirmation, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
